## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; mixed signals with Risk -3 vs Cycle +1 and weak breadth plus leadership concentration -> caution. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 span 3 sectors) and major mega-cap divergence suppresses strong regime conviction.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Materials lead: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +23.88%). Consumer Discretionary strong on tops: TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +21.75%), GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +21.27%). Financials showing pockets of strength: COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%), C ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +17.65%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Energy weak: XOM BELOW TREND (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -0.28%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -1.70%). Utilities lag: NEE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -5.01%), DUK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -5.70%). Consumer Staples mixed despite EL outperformance: COST BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -4.22%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.90% | 1M: +25.16%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), NEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +23.88%), TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +21.75%), GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.45% | 1M: +21.27%). Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/value tilt but breadth is weak.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: COST BELOW TREND (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -4.22%), APD BELOW TREND (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -4.43%), VLO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -4.75%), NEE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -5.01%), AEP BELOW TREND (1W: -1.11% | 1M: -5.30%); weakness concentrated in Energy/Utilities.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strong 1W movers: EL (1W: +6.90%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +19.34%), FCX (1W: +3.43%). Watch RECOVERY candidates showing 1W bounce vs weak 1M: ORCL RECOVERY (1W: +3.81% | 1M: -8.89%), TMUS RECOVERY (1W: +0.29% | 1M: -6.08%), NFLX RECOVERY (1W: +0.66% | 1M: -10.67%). Major divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, GOOGL, JNJ, UNH) — tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed with pockets of strength. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.34% | 1M: +1.57%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +0.20%), META ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +11.91%); AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.79%), GOOGL CORRECTION (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +6.19%). Sector performance mixed despite headline names holding gains.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Selective strength but uneven internals. V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +7.87%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.40%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%), while JPM is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +6.31%). Financials favored tactically, but breadth is not broad.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive names showing short-term strain. LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +2.70%), but JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -3.64% | 1M: +2.27%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -4.01% | 1M: +5.80%), PFE CORRECTION (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.24%). Sector trending weaker on the week.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Materials and select Financials and autos (FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), COF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +20.53%), TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +21.75%)). Reduce exposure to Utilities and Energy given clear BELOW TREND signals (NEE, XOM, CVX). Monitor mega-cap divergences and RECOVERY setups (ORCL, TMUS) for tactical entries, not core shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.90% | 1M: +25.16%), FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.18% | 1M: +19.34%).  
BEARISH: NEE BELOW TREND (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -5.01%), VLO BELOW TREND (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -4.75%), CVX BELOW TREND (1W: -1.37% | 1M: -1.70%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +10.34%) and selective Financials (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +10.73%) given strong leaders.  
BEARISH: Energy (1W: -3.02% | 1M: -0.26%) and Utilities (1W: -1.12% | 1M: -4.13%) where multiple names are BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA resistance test — watch for failure above near-term highs to signal momentum loss (NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +0.20%)). AAPL support watch around recent multi-week pivot to confirm CORRECTION vs breakdown (AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.79%)). JPM breakout hold would validate Financials follow-through (JPM CORRECTION (1W: -0.88% | 1M: +6.31%)). Materials relative strength hold (FCX ABOVE TREND) would reinforce the rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Materials and select Financials showing strength while breadth is weak. FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.43% | 1M: +24.02%), EL ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.90% | 1M: +25.16%), TSLA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.24% | 1M: +21.75%) are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among mega-caps and multiple CORRECTIONs (AAPL, GOOGL, JNJ) — watch for confirmation before shifting core exposures.
